This suggests a potential functional relationship where Promazine may share a similar mechanism of action with Acepromazine, which directly interacts with Drd2. The lowest common ancestor of Promazine and Acepromazine places them within the broader category of agents affecting the nervous system, implying a possible role in modulating dopamine receptor activity. The integration of these relationships supports the hypothesis that Promazine may interact with Drd2 through a mechanism similar to that of Acepromazine, potentially influencing dopamine receptor function.
